patterns.note: Alternates between a warm cream background and high-contrast dark charcoal blocks to segment trust-focused content and pricing.
Elegant serif headings paired with clean, highly legible sans-serif body copy, creating an editorial yet modern educational feel.
A signature soft yellow accent color is used consistently for primary CTAs, highlighted table columns, and background gradient washes.

Features an interactive tabbed switcher where clicking left-hand accordion items updates the corresponding UI mockup on the right, paired with a Lottie animation in the hero simulating real-time transcription.
A distinctive comparison table ('Made for the classroom') that uses a full-height brand-colored yellow column to visually dominate and draw focus to the product's advantages.

technique_notes: Recreate the interactive feature section by binding accordion state triggers to a dynamic media container on the right, swapping out UI mockups or playing specific Lottie animations when a new tab is activated. The hero uses a video-hero overlay card with a simulated Lottie progress indicator to visually demonstrate the 'transcribing' value proposition immediately.

To achieve the warm, trustworthy educational aesthetic, use a soft cream background instead of pure white, paired with deep charcoal typography for softer contrast. Use generous rounded corners on all cards and image containers to maintain a friendly, approachable feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant editorial serif headings (~3.5x body size) paired with clean, medium-weight sans-serif body text and small uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to rounded: cards and image containers use a consistent medium-soft corner radius (~16px to 24px) to feel approachable.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and balanced, with generous vertical padding between major sections and tight, structured grids within feature blocks.

standout: The site beautifully balances an editorial, high-trust aesthetic with interactive product demos. The standout feature is the seamless integration of warm, human photography with clean, yellow-accented UI mockups that make complex AI tutoring tools feel tangible and easy to use.
